title: RSSB Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026
summary: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) , has released a notification on its official website for the recruitment of Junior Engineer (JE) Posts. This recruitment is for 1909 positions. RSSB Application Form will start on 18 November 2026 & the candidates can apply until 17 December 2026 . Minimum age required is 18 Years & The Maximum Age Is 40 Years as on 01 January 2027. Candidates must check the complete details for RSSB Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026. which has given below. ( Advt. No. 10/2026 )
qualification: Candidates must have completed their Degree or Diploma in Engineering from a university established by law in India or from a recognized Institution. Practical knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari script and knowledge of Rajasthani culture. Read Official Notification For Post Wise Qualification.
